text:
noor: short UX sync - re: prompt-sets / evals approval. Idea: move from one overloaded \"Approve\" CTA to a compact two-step pattern: inline \"Fast approve\" for triage + \"Confirm & Archive\" for permanent sign-off that stores a snapshot and audit link. keeps quick flows snappy but makes permanence explicit.

vince: what's the core problem? accidental audits, unclear copy, or downstream tooling needing an audit id?

noor: all three. customers reported accidental sign-offs during triage and then having to hunt for who did it. Confirm & Archive gives a clear intent and an audit artifact we can link from other tooling.

anjali: backend notes: we can emit evals.archive.v1 event when Confirm & Archive is used. payload: user_id, mode: fast|archive, prompt_set_sha, count, audit_id, archive_url (if large). snapshot storage gated per-org. small storage + indexing change.

rex: accessibility: two nearby CTAs with similar labels are risky for screen reader users. Suggest a segmented control with aria-checked states OR a grouped pair with role=\"group\" and clear legend. The archive path must show an accessible confirmation (alertdialog) with focus trap and a short summary of what will be archived. Also announce the audit id using aria-live after completion.

sam: research POV: testers preferred distinct verbs - \"Fast approve\" vs \"Confirm & Archive\" makes intent clear. Also people expect a small preview of what will be archived for bulk ops. Preview reduces anxiety.

noor: mock (link) shows a compact split control: left = Fast approve (primary), right = Confirm & Archive (secondary). Secondary opens a sliding sheet with small preview and optional 1-line note. Proposed copy: 
```
Primary: Fast approve
Secondary: Confirm & Archive
Tooltip on secondary: Create an immutable snapshot and audit entry
Confirm sheet title: Archive snapshot for N tests?
Confirm body: A snapshot will be stored and an audit ID created. This action is permanent.
Buttons: [Cancel] [Confirm & Archive]
```

vince: short copy suggestion: \"Confirm + Archive\" or \"Archive (confirm)\"? shorter tends to fit more UIs.

noor: ok try \"Confirm + Archive\" in the compact UI. full label stays in the sheet.

rex: a11y nit: avoid relying on hover/tooltips. Add visible microcopy below the actions and an sr-only paragraph that spells out the difference. Link the sr-only to each button via aria-describedby. Make the confirm sheet an alertdialog (aria-modal=true) and put the audit id in the dialog footer after creation so SR users can copy it. Use role=status for the toast.

anjali: keyboard plan: Mod+Enter = Fast approve, Mod+Shift+Enter = Confirm + Archive. If sheet is open, Enter on the primary confirm triggers archive. Frontend telemetry: include trigger=ui|shortcut|api and confirmation=true|false. For large bulk (>300) we default to archive_url and include a manifest instead of full snapshot to reduce cost.

sam: usability: surface the shortcut hint inline for first 3 uses (dismissible). also surface a subtle \"preview\" CTA in the sheet so people can inspect the snapshot before confirming. Recruit 6 participants: 4 general, 2 SR. Watch for accidental archive rate.

noor: QA checklist to add to PR: focus order, group labeling and aria-describedby, alertdialog semantics, keyboard shortcuts and discoverability hint, preview accessibility, toast/audit id discoverable and copyable, bulk preview summarization (domains/counts), contrast tokens.

vince: rollout plan: behind org-level feature flag. conservative beta to single enterprise org. metrics: % fast vs archive, undo within 5 minutes, rate of archives per org. Provide admin toggle to enforce required note for archive for strict customers.

ops-bot: Created issue #6010: \"evals: confirm-and-archive flow + snapshot event\" and assigned to anjali.

anjali: dev estimate: UI + sheet + preview ~3d, backend event + snapshot store + archive pipeline ~3d, feature flag + admin toggle ~1d, QA ~1d. total ~8 dev days across frontend+backend.

rex: extra a11y test item: automated script should assert aria-describedby targets exist and the alertdialog label matches visible title. Add data attributes for testing e.g. data-qa-approval-mode=\"archive\".

sam: decision: proceed with compact Fast approve / Confirm + Archive pattern behind flag, include shortcuts + preview + a11y checklist. run beta and then widen.

noor: action items: @anjali open draft schema PR (attach sample payload), @rex add a11y checklist to PR template, @sam schedule 6 moderated sessions. I'll update figma and post link when branch is up.

anjali: ack, will branch tomorrow and attach schema mock.

rex: will PR checklist.

sam: invites sent.

noor: thanks all :sparkles:
